testCases.label: Test case where the target is not in the array
testCases.description: Verifies that the method returns 'true' when the target value '5' is absent from the array {0, 1, 2, 3, 4}.

testCases.label: Test case where the target is present in the array
testCases.description: Verifies that the method returns 'false' when the target value '4' is present in the array {0, 1, 2, 3, 4}.

testCases.label: Test case with different array values, target is absent
testCases.description: Verifies that the method returns 'true' when the target value '5' is absent from the array {8, 7, 3, 6}.

testCases.label: Test case with duplicate values, target is present
testCases.description: Verifies that the method returns 'false' when the target value '7' is present (and duplicated) in the array {9, 7, 7, 3}.
